verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs clearly describe reusable Templates that define a starting layout applied to every new Object of a Type (anytype-docs-13, anytype-docs-22), including custom icon/cover (anytype-docs-25), and Types define structured Properties (anytype-docs-32, anytype-docs-46) which could hold title/date fields. However, no evidence describes dynamic variable interpolation (e.g., auto-populating today's date or title placeholders) within a template — only static layout/property definitions are documented. Missing for 10: explicit support for dynamic variables (auto-filled date, title placeholders) in templates, and any hands-on/community confirmation of this variable behavior.
